name: Gijeogui Bunsikjip
source:
Try to find love while managing a Korean snack shop.

Manage your own snack shop as you try to win love and success! Feel the characters' emotions as you listen to the Korean voice acting in this detailed visual novel.

Due to financial troubles, our main character is gifted his own snack shop.
But one day, a mysterious portal appears in the attic apartment, and a queen from an icy realm jumps through!
How are you going to balance love and business as the story plays out before your eyes?!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/995460/]Steam[/url]]

This is a spin-off of a [url=https://www.joara.com/nobless/bookPartList.html?bookCode=1267766]web novel[/url] with the same name.
translation:
一边经营韩国小吃店，一边寻找爱情。

管理自己的小吃店，努力赢得爱情与成功，聆听韩语配音，感受角色们的情感。

由于经济困难，主人公得到了一家属于自己的小吃店。但某天，阁楼公寓里出现神秘传送门，一名冰雪国度的女王从中跳了出来！

随着故事在你眼前展开，你将如何平衡爱情与生意？

这是同名网络小说的衍生作。

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/995460/]Steam[/url]及[url=https://www.joara.com/nobless/bookPartList.html?bookCode=1267766]网络小说[/url]]
